item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:

Die verfügbaren Daten zeigen ernst zu nehmende Risiken, aber keinen wirtschaftlichen freien Fall.

item.title: Turkey’s Inflation Falls to 31.75% | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Turkey’s inflation rate declined again in July, but the figures offer little relief for households facing persistently high food, housing, and service costs. Consumer prices rose another 1.78 percent within a single month, while the new inflation reading raised the maximum rent adjustment benchmark for qualifying August lease renewals to 31.90 percent. The decline in the annual rate therefore marks slower inflation, not lower prices.

item.title: Yen Shock: US and Japan Launch Joint Intervention | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Washington and Tokyo have taken the exceptional step of intervening together to strengthen the Japanese yen after the currency approached its weakest level in four decades. The operation has moved far beyond a bilateral exchange-rate dispute. It now touches Japanese inflation, US government debt, global carry trades and the credibility of monetary policy in both countries.

item.title: Todd Blanche Rescinds Trump’s $1.8 Billion Fund | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche has formally rescinded the Trump administration’s controversial $1.8 billion Anti-Weaponization Fund, removing a major obstacle to his nomination as the permanent head of the Justice Department. The decision followed sustained resistance from Republican senators who demanded more than verbal assurances that the program would never become operational. Blanche’s nomination can now move forward, but neither his confirmation nor the complete legal extinction of the fund is guaranteed.

item.title: Putin’s Strategic Miscalculation: The War Has Reached Moscow | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Vladimir Putin launched the invasion of Ukraine expecting to overwhelm the country politically and militarily within a short period of time. More than four years later, Ukrainian drones are reaching the Moscow region in large numbers, striking logistical and economic targets and forcing Russia to devote growing resources to the defense of its own capital. The war the Kremlin intended to wage on Ukrainian territory, insulated from everyday life in Russia’s political center, has returned to the heart of Putin’s system of power.

item.title: Ein Blackout als Systemkrise: Private Vorbereitung | newsmedia.report

item.description:
Niemand kann seriös vorhersagen, ob Europa im Herbst oder Winter 2026/27 einen flächendeckenden Blackout erleben wird. item.title: Drones Reach Omsk Again as Russia’s Industrial Rear Comes Under Pressure | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Russian authorities imposed a drone alert across the Siberian region of Omsk on Sunday, temporarily restricted airport operations and reported the interception of at least one unmanned aircraft near the city. No strike on the region’s vast oil refinery or military infrastructure has been confirmed, but the incident renews a strategic question that Moscow can no longer dismiss: how secure is Russia’s industrial heartland when drones can threaten targets more than 2,500 kilometers from Ukraine?

item.title: Three Dead, Seven Injured in Idaho In-N-Out Shooting | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
A shooting near a newly opened In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho, has left three people dead and seven others injured, some critically. The suspected gunman was found dead near the restaurant, but authorities have not yet clarified whether he is included in the reported death toll. As investigators reconstruct the attack, viral videos and unverified claims about a second armed person are complicating an already sensitive case.

item.title: Trump Halts Planned Iran Strikes | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
President Donald Trump says the United States has canceled a planned new attack on Iran while regional governments attempt to finalize a framework that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and address Iran’s nuclear program. Israel will also refrain from launching new strikes for now, according to Trump. Tehran, however, has not publicly confirmed that it has accepted the proposed terms, and no signed peace agreement has been announced.

item.title: EU AI Act: Diese Pflichten gelten jetzt für Unternehmen | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Mit dem 2. August 2026 erreicht die europäische KI Regulierung eine entscheidende Stufe. Neue Transparenzpflichten betreffen Chatbots, KI Agenten, synthetische Bilder und Stimmen, Deepfakes sowie bestimmte automatisch erzeugte Texte. Unternehmen müssen nun klären, welche Systeme sie einsetzen, welche Rolle sie rechtlich einnehmen und an welcher Stelle eine technische oder sichtbare Kennzeichnung erforderlich ist.

item.title: Ukraine Sinks the Russian Ship Yanina | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Ukraine has sunk the Russian container ship Yanina with naval drones in the Black Sea. The vessel was operated by FESCO, a logistics group controlled by Russia’s state nuclear corporation Rosatom, but Moscow says it was carrying only civilian goods. The attack opens a far more consequential dispute over military targets, commercial shipping and the legal boundaries of maritime warfare.

item.title: Israel or the Homeland: U.S. Faces a Defense Tradeoff | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
A reported warning from America’s top military commander in Europe has exposed a strategic problem Washington can no longer treat as theoretical. General Alexus Grynkewich is said to have informed Pentagon leaders that without another Navy destroyer, he could be forced to prioritize the defense of the United States over continued missile protection for Israel. The warning has not been publicly confirmed in full, and no decision to reduce Israel’s protection has been announced. Even so, the reported message points to a widening gap between the military commitments the United States has accumulated and the forces immediately available to sustain them.

item.title: Europas Immobilienmarkt vor der Neuordnung | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Europas Immobilienbranche hat den Zinsschock überstanden, doch sie kehrt nicht in die vertraute Welt billigen Geldes zurück. Wohnraum bleibt knapp und teuer, Gewerbeimmobilien werden härter nach Qualität getrennt, energetische Anforderungen verändern Bewertungen und Geschäftsmodelle. Der Markt stabilisiert sich, aber diese Stabilisierung folgt einer neuen Ordnung: Kapital, Lage, Nutzung und technische Qualität entscheiden stärker als früher über Erfolg oder Bedeutungsverlust.

item.title: Japan’s Earthquake Crisis Deepens Amid Heat, Water and Factory Disruptions | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Four days after a powerful earthquake struck southern Japan, the emergency has moved far beyond collapsed buildings. Officials now report 36 deaths, while 72,000 households remain without running water and thousands of residents face extreme heat in shelters, vehicles and damaged homes. At the same time, disruptions across Kyushu’s semiconductor and automotive corridor are raising questions about consequences that could extend well beyond Japan.

item.title: America’s Water Systems Under Attack | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
More than 30 municipal water systems in Minnesota were targeted within two days, while similar incidents were reported across at least seven US states. The attacks did not contaminate drinking water, but they reached the digital controls responsible for pressure, pumping, treatment, and other physical operations. What initially appeared to be a regional cybersecurity incident has become a national warning about the vulnerability of essential public infrastructure.

item.description:

item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Der Angriff auf eine Mädchenschule im südiranischen Minab gehört zu den schwersten Vorfällen mit zivilen Opfern im Krieg zwischen den Vereinigten Staaten und Iran. Vorläufige amerikanische Ermittlungen deuten darauf hin, dass eine von den USA eingesetzte Rakete das Schulgelände traf und veraltete Zieldaten dabei eine entscheidende Rolle gespielt haben könnten. Monate später hält das Pentagon seinen Untersuchungsbericht weiterhin zurück, während frühere Einschnitte bei den Schutzmechanismen für Zivilisten die Frage nach der politischen Verantwortung von Verteidigungsminister Pete Hegseth verschärfen.

item.description:

Diese Konstruktion gefährdet nicht nur einzelne Unternehmen, sondern die Verlässlichkeit des digitalen Wirtschaftsraums.

item.description:

item.title: La France sait, les victimes attendent encore | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: newsmedia.report Editorial Team
item.description:
Depuis plusieurs années, la France reconnaît plus clairement l’ampleur des violences sexuelles, modifie son droit et annonce de nouveaux dispositifs. Pourtant, entre la révélation des faits, le dépôt de plainte, l’enquête, la protection et l’accès aux soins, la chaîne institutionnelle se rompt encore trop souvent. item.title: The Refinancing Trap Deepens | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
US mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level in roughly a year, deepening the affordability crisis for buyers and prolonging the wait for homeowners who expected to refinance. The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate unchanged, but a divided vote, persistent inflation and renewed energy-market pressure offered little reason to expect immediate relief. item.title: Zelenskyy and Netanyahu Seek Trump’s Support | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Benjamin Netanyahu are arriving at the White House on the same day with different wars, different demands and the same indispensable audience. Their meetings with Donald Trump are formally separate, but they expose a common strategic problem: Washington is being asked to supply weapons, political backing and diplomatic leverage across two conflicts whose costs and risks continue to rise. The decisive question is not which leader receives the warmer welcome. It is whether Trump is prepared to convert presidential attention into durable commitments, and which conflict he considers more useful to pressure, contain or end.

item.title: Congo’s Ebola Crisis Enters Its Deadliest Phase | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,262 confirmed cases and 1,437 deaths, bringing the country close to the scale of its worst previous epidemic. Uganda has declared its outbreak over, but transmission in eastern Congo continues to accelerate amid armed conflict, disrupted health services, unpaid medical workers and the absence of an approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo virus. The immediate danger remains concentrated in Central and East Africa, yet the crisis is now a test of whether international intervention can move faster than the epidemic.

item.title: Österreichs innere Sicherheit im Stresstest | newsmedia.report
item.dc:creator: Sinisa Brkic (sb)
item.description:
Österreich ist kein unsicheres Land. Doch die Sicherheitslage verändert sich schneller, als es klassische Kriminalitätszahlen erkennen lassen. Gewalt, digitale Kriminalität, Extremismus und Angriffe auf kritische Systeme verlangen von Polizei und Behörden eine neue Form staatlicher Handlungsfähigkeit: spezialisierter, vernetzter und zugleich rechtsstaatlich kontrolliert.
